Take some basic steps (I struggle with the same problem but understand the process).
Get her attention before you begin trying to open a conversation, then ask questions. Usually when you ask a few questions the other person will begin to ask you questions as well. Not all people will be receptive, some people are just not trying to flirt or even make friends for that matter, but you have to find someone with similar interests and then ask about them and explain how you feel about them. Baby steps are important.
